title: Heli's Vom/p ModPack (will not be updated)
body:
# THIS MODPACK IS MEANT FOR LOW/MEDIUM PCS

The name stands for Very Ordinary Optimized ModPack

This modpack captures the Vanilla feel but makes it harder and more challeging
and to balance it all out adds some mods to help you progress!
Make sure to join the "Read pls!" world

In case your lagging simply try configuring settings or turning off shaders
if that doesnt help alocate more ram to minecraft.

This my first ever modpack.
Made by HeliExists.
